claims.runtime_boundary: Audience/task relevance is a heuristic, not a universal psychological law.
Syntactic complexity can cost processing; do not infer a universal sentence-length threshold.
Stop-word rhetoric remains candidate-only because the source itself supplies functional exceptions.
Self-persuasion effects are conditional; do not encode self-inference as a universal trust mechanism.
Parentheses are not mechanically unimportant.
No POS-class ban on participles or gerunds; inspect actual dependency load.
Passive/noncanonical processing effects are structure- and task-dependent; passive remains legitimate.
One-new-thought is an editorial model, not a universal cognitive unit.
Skimming can privilege starts of units under constraints; never assume a universal F-pattern.
Use dominant-topic structure contextually; no universal one-topic count.
Communication model only.
Value/genre decision, scoped to applied informational text.
Structure can aid comprehension/navigation in relevant tasks; do not score universal interest.
Choose medium by task-relevant information; never rank image above text globally.
No universal hierarchy of personal experience, demonstration, illustration and text.
Do not encode a two-item taxonomy as a psychological truth; commercial brainstorming only.
Text may contribute to commercial outcomes; never promise sales or fixed effects.
Business-model claim excluded from runtime.
Overbroad business-causal claim excluded from runtime.
Ground abstractions when useful; never ban abstraction.
Keep audience/numeracy review; do not simplify numbers automatically.
Review provenance and measurement, not precision as a defect by itself.
Adjacent numbers remain a layout/design review, not a cognitive-law detector.
Require honesty/evidence; never assume recruiters reliably detect lies.
Good response does not guarantee invitation; preserve causal humility.
Attributed editorial philosophy only.
Historical Главред behavior/thresholds do not transfer to current runtime.
Do not infer education, intelligence or thoughtfulness from headline preference.
Test transparency of wording, never infer author motives such as cowardice.
Structure helps some task-oriented exposition; stream-of-consciousness remains a legitimate genre device.
Broad language/cognition causal thesis is unnecessary for editing and excluded from runtime.
Syntactic load is real; comma count remains only a crude METRIC_ONLY proxy.
